catalog_quirks.body: Gizmo Free includes 1,000 zero-cost-model API requests per calendar month, shared by account and reset on the first day UTC. Only tested :free routes are included. The chat endpoint accepts text only: tools, image/audio messages and structured output are unsupported. Six exact-model routes returned valid text with usage.cost=0 on 2026-10-03. Selected adapter chat and streaming checks also passed. Paid-model weekly credits did not bypass the account payment-method requirement. https://gizmoplatforms.com/developers?tab=docs
